scope: Diagnostic-only interaction and pressed-pixel mapping of the public GTK2 preview; no product source or user theme changed.

observations.result: top vertical and both horizontal appeared pressed; bottom vertical did not; bottom click emitted no distinct event during its measured interval.
press pixels for bottom vertical were seen at tested y=182..193; the direct scripted click at prior y=188 was inconsistent across runs. This was exploratory input mapping, not an acceptance run.

some points in the left/up/down allocation produced GTK2 value and 53-pixel state changes. The sweep did not establish a stable public test; its right-direction ROI was later found to use stale vertical geometry and is excluded.
corrected right scan at x=221..235 produced no value/state change; a normal run using mapped candidate points x=19/233 and y=20/191 still failed at left before reaching the other directions.

diagnosis: Public-preview input/state capture is not reproducible with the current xdotool/Xephyr harness. Some misses come from target coordinates outside the active stepper region; other runs with mapped coordinates still miss. No product correction is justified yet. The direct GTK2 scene R6 passed its four-state check, but does not resolve the public route.
